## What this region is

The tools an agent runs while changing template code and how they are wired: the package.json scripts, Biome with the custom lint scripts and CI rules, and the Turborepo task graph with the shared @inixiative/config toolchain presets.

## What it exists for

- Run a production process
- Start, stop or reset local database containers
- Lint, format or gate code before pushing
- Run the repo's custom lint and CI rule checks
- Configure Biome and pre-commit hooks from the shared presets
- Build and type-check a package with the right shared preset
- Keep a repo's toolchain pinned and release ecosystem packages
- Generate code (OpenAPI, clients) from the schema

## How people say these problems

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- What do I call the two ends of this relation → conventions
- Which import path do I use → monorepo-architecture
- Only do this in prod → environments-deploy
- Get this repo running on my machine → dx-setup
- Is this repo on the shared typescript and biome versions → lib-config
